pages.title: Axiom Distiller
pages.text: Day 212. The source code has a floor, and something lies beneath it. The $(item)Axiom Distiller$() boils reality down past its code to the axioms underneath, and condenses them into fragments.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 7$() machine.

What is an axiom? In mathematics, a statement accepted without proof - the bedrock every theorem is derived from. Change the axioms and you change what can be true. Holding a fragment of one is like holding a rule in my hand. It hums.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 3 fluid inputs, 2 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Absolute Infinity, Axiom Fragment, Crystallised Law, Primordial Law.
